# Membrane Hackney plugin v0.11.2 - Table of Contents

> HTTP sink/source based on hackney

## Pages

- [Membrane Hackney plugin](https://membrane-hackney-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [License](https://membrane-hackney-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.Hackney.Sink](https://membrane-hackney-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Hackney.Sink.md): An element uploading data over HTTP(S) based on Hackney
- [Membrane.Hackney.Sink.Response](https://membrane-hackney-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Hackney.Sink.Response.md): Struct containing HTTP response sent to pipeline via notification after the upload is finished.

- [Membrane.Hackney.Source](https://membrane-hackney-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Hackney.Source.md): This module provides a source element allowing you to receive data as a client
using HTTP. It is based upon [Hackney](https://github.com/benoitc/hackney)
library that is responsible for making HTTP requests.
